answer:
Superconductivity was discovered on **April 8, 1911**, by Dutch physicist Heike Kamerlingh Onnes at Leiden University. At that time, **William Howard Taft** was the President of the United States. 

Taft served as the 27th president from March 4, 1909, to March 4, 1913, so he was in office during the discovery of this groundbreaking phenomenon.
